results.rationale: Consistency: excluding the requested viewpoint change, the botanical print and its lettering disappear, and the visible silver retaining clips are lost; the black rectangular frame and white backdrop remain. Instruction: the frame turns to an opposite oblique view, but still presents a broad glass face; the reference requires a narrow side profile with the tall triangular rear support exposed. This is a substantial perspective and occlusion mismatch. Quality: considered alone, the rectangular frame, glass reflections, joints and visible wire base are coherent and clean, without noticeable generation artifacts.

Consistency: excluding the requested setting, placement, palette and lighting changes, the cabinet changes from three drawers to four and its beveled top and base molding become flatter, differently shaped trim; round knobs and the general cabinet identity remain. Instruction: the edit supplies a warm white wall, pale wood floor, right-side linen curtain and angled sunlight with a calm neutral palette. However, the cabinet sits essentially centrally and the bottom-right thin text is garbled instead of the specified sentence, so compliance is partial. Quality: the lighting, floor grain and curtain texture are convincing, but the caption contains conspicuously malformed lettering and the cabinet top has irregular, warped trim edges.
